The opening animation heavily uses footage from the second Japanese opening, The Rivals. It debuted in EP081, replacing . From EP117 onward, it began using footage from OK!. The full version of this song was used as the opening theme for the Korean dub of The Power of One. The full version of this song can be found on the CDs Pocket Monsters OST (Vol. 2) and Pocket Monsters AG (New & Best).
plainText:
Pokémon Forever (Korean: 포켓몬 Forever Poketmon Forever) is the second and final opening theme for the Korean dub of the original series. The opening animation heavily uses footage from the second Japanese opening, The Rivals. It debuted in EP081, replacing . From EP117 onward, it began using footage from OK!. The full version of this song was used as the opening theme for the Korean dub of The Power of One. The full version of this song can be found on the CDs Pocket Monsters OST (Vol. 2) and Pocket Monsters AG (New & Best).

==Synopsis==
The opening starts with a brief view of a battlefield which quickly changes into a . The ball opens and the Pokémon logo comes out, appearing over water. then appears running and enters with a jump. making its appearance, followed by and then making a roar. The next scene features , , and . The background changes as appears singing. then comes up, then only to be attacked by . scares Squirtle away with an Electric attack. makes its entrance and uses . The earth is shown next as Thunderbolt comes out. and Pikachu appears in battle against Sparky and Ritchie. The screen split into four and shows various Pokémon doing attacks. This changes to a dark stadium where Ash is seen standing with his head low. and , as well as and Delia Ketchum are watching him from the sidelines. The two girls seem concerned. Ash's fist trembles, then opens. Light is cast on him as he raises his head with a confident smile. Afterward, Ash and Ritchie shake hands.

The scene changes to the sea where Pikachu and are seen riding on 's head. Ash, Misty and Tracey are riding on Lapras's back, while Goldeen and Staryu are swimming. , on the other hand, seems to be drowning. Nurse Joy and Officer Jenny pass by riding on a motorboat. Jessie, James, and appear standing on their submarine. A then swats them away with its tail. 

The next scene features Lapras and the gang again, shot from behind. Psyduck is hanging onto Lapras, while Goldeen and Staryu are in the water. Pikachu and Togepi are still on Lapras's head, while the Trainers are on its back, all are laughing. The next scene shows Lapras and the gang again, looking up at the sky, with the sun setting over the horizon.

==Lyrics==
===TV Size===
 
! Korean
! English

 

 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 

 
 
 

There is no one who can take my place!

The unavoidable time of destiny
I’ll show you everything! (Pikachu!)
Winning or losing is not important
Because we were friends from the beginning

I can’t win all the time
I won’t be disappointed again
Clenching my two fists
Standing up again, like this

Firmly take an oath as you open your eyes in the morning 
I’ll show you myself, growing a little bit at a time 
Unchanging Pokémon Forever 

===Full version===
 
! Korean
! English

 

 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 

There is no one who can take my place!

The unavoidable time of destiny
I’ll show you everything (Pikachu!)
Winning or losing is not important
Because we were friends from the beginning

I can’t win all the time
I won’t be disappointed again
Clenching my two fists I stand up again
I’ll open up the wings in my heart, like this

Forget all the bad memories
Firmly take an oath as you open your eyes in the morning 
That I’ll show myself grow a little bit at a time 
Like the fiery sun that shines upon the smiling tomorrow
Unchanging Pokémon Forever

I’m not you. I’m only racing ahead for myself
I’m proud of my reflection in your eyes (Pikachu!)
I'm racing to the end with all my strength
And trying to smile nicely as well

Often there will be times where I’ll regret this
But I’ll never look back
Shaking off all of yesterday’s work 
I’ll call tomorrow’s dreams with all my might, like this

Forget all the bad memories
Firmly take an oath as you open your eyes in the morning
I’ll show you myself, growing a little bit at a time 
Like the fiery sun that shines upon the smiling tomorrow
Unchanging Pokémon Forever (Forever, Forever)
